_why: Classification of routes that no code calls. Patterns are regexes matched against 'METHOD /path'; the first match wins. Classes: operator-action (state-changing, used by an operator or the UI), human-view (read-only view for a person or the UI), file-read (the consumer reads the same store directly, not over HTTP), covered (another route or tool already gives the consumer this data), candidate-gap (data that no code reads and that a pipeline step or agent might need: a decision, not a bug). A route that matches nothing is UNCLASSIFIED and is listed in the registry header.

notes.reason: state-changing route; called by an operator, the UI or a scheduler outside the code scanned, never by another service
the agent and reflection read the same strategy-evaluation database directly (edge evaluation_status->agent.idea_prompt), not over HTTP
the live-decision agent gets Track-2 moves through `unconfirmed_moves[]` in get_live_decision_context (see its AGENT.md); no dedicated tool by decision
news impact / threat classification is stored and shown but no gate or agent reads it (see 04 status, Open: News)
calibration and graveyard are written and used in-process; nothing reads these views, check whether an agent should
older analysis views; research and strategy read story / drawdown / correlation / angle instead, check whether these are still needed
agent sessions, swarm runs, broker limits and overrides, safety ledger, settings: read by a person or the UI
service settings: read by a person or the UI
model service status and angle list for an operator
visibility routes (order ledger, lockouts, slippage, snapshots, decisions needing a size) for an operator; reflection reads the live data files
allocation history, not-funded, game plan, weights: operator views
introspection and report routes for an operator (pipeline-edge report, parity report, generation rounds, sweeps, hypotheses)
news ingestion status, feeds, providers, threads and article lists for an operator or the UI
rules, rankers, pairlist, churn, history: operator views (the agent reads rankers through /latest)
backtest result detail for an operator (the agent reads equity and weights)
data catalog and backfill status for an operator
factor and model catalog, feature requests: operator and UI views
coverage and manifest views for an operator (the agent computes coverage itself from /angles)
strategy YAML reference and settings for a person
pending synthesis list for an operator; the worker reads its own store
job status poll for a person who triggered a run
emergency flatten / halt status for an operator
